description: The donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different types of stimuli used in the context of generative AI’s application in journalism, as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, shown in dark red, followed by “Press Release” at 18.7% (yellow) and “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green). Other notable segments include “Interview” (8.8%, purple), “Organizational Report” (7.7%, light purple), and “Event Posting” (6.6%, maroon). Smaller segments include “Organizational Website” and “Intra-agency news article” (both 4.9%, light blue and navy respectively), “Email” (2.7%, light green), and “Social Media Post” (1.1%, orange). The chart uses a color-coded legend implicitly through direct labeling, with no separate legend box, and percentages are displayed next to each segment. The segments are arranged clockwise starting from the top right, with no apparent ordering by size, and the central white space contains the title “Stimulus Type” in bold black text.
